title: How to Become a Tech Conference Speaker (And Why You Might Regret It)
why_read: A personal, candid account of the realities of conference speaking, useful career advice but not a technical deep dive.
analysis: This is a first-person blog post about the practical and emotional realities of being a tech conference speaker, covering rejection, preparation workload, and logistics. It's useful soft-skills content for engineers considering public speaking, but contains no technical substance about code, systems, or tools. Value is mainly for career development rather than technical learning.
